decisions.question: ISS-707: should Forge hold a per-project SSH CA key in core and mint short-lived per-run certificates for the servers a project operates? Triage T1D: the gap is real, but no requirement covers it; the build is xl (migration, core CA and grant ledger, a runner release) and must be split.
decisions.changes: What the run that asked goes on with
decisions.impact: The run that asked waits on this; it goes on once it has your answer.

answers.label: Yes, read-only grants first: a requirement scoped to read-only access

No: server access stays operator-managed outside Forge; drop ISS-707
